notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1145180_canopus.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. In shallow water in Aboukir Bay, off Abu Qir: the long masonry wall of the Serapeum (about 103 m by 3 m) and the lower walls of the building, granite and marble columns standing broken or fallen, capitals and bases, limestone blocks, stone anchors and amphorae. The statues found here have been raised. The layout, the sizes and the depth are approximate. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
